_comment: Generic evidence envelope (klayout-tools#1152, `"kind": "generic"`) wrapping
docs/characterization-report.md so `klt signoff --manifest` can grade T1 item 8.
Item 8 is the ONLY T1 item a generic envelope may satisfy; items 3-7 reject it
(klayout-tools#2044), and since #2044 item 8 accepts nothing else.
WHAT `status: "pass"` ASSERTS HERE -- read this before citing the verdict.
Item 8's pass condition is about the ARTIFACT, not about the rows inside it:
'one aggregated, current artifact summarizing per-spec-row performance across
conditions, with the evidence record each verdict rests on'. This envelope
asserts exactly that and nothing more:
- docs/characterization-report.md exists and covers EVERY row of
spec/target-spec.md's Target table, including the rows that fail or are
unmeasured (coverage honesty is part of that report's own contract);
- every row names the evidence record(s) its verdict rests on;
- it is GENERATED, not hand-written (`python3 sim/report/generate.py --write`),
and its currency is enforced on every push by `sim/report/generate.py --check`
(wired into `npm run check:ci` as `npm run check:report`), which fails if a
cited record was superseded, a citation path no longer resolves, or the
committed Markdown drifted from what the current records would regenerate.
It does NOT assert that the ADC meets its spec. As of the pinned revision the
report records ENOB and INL/DNL as DOES-NOT-MEET against DR-007's (still
unratified) candidate targets, and Sample rate and Power as UNMEASURED. Those
are items 5 and 6's subject, not item 8's -- see signoff/README.md.
FRESHNESS. `provenance.input.content_hash` is the sha256 of the artifact named
by `source`. `klt signoff` reports `input_verified: null` for every generic
citation -- a generic envelope's author chooses their own field names, so the
grader cannot re-hash `source` the way it re-hashes a `klt drc` envelope's
`file` (klayout-tools#2196's kind table). signoff/check-evidence-hashes.py
closes that hole in-repo instead: it re-hashes `source` on every push, headless,
and fails if this pin no longer describes the committed Markdown. Filed
generically upstream so the grader can eventually anchor it itself.
summary: Aggregated characterization report: every spec/target-spec.md Target-table row rendered with its verdict, conditions, and the evidence record(s) it rests on, including failing and unmeasured rows. Generated by sim/report/generate.py; staleness-gated in CI by `sim/report/generate.py --check`.
